title: Implement a Resizable Circular Deque
prompt:
Implement ResizableDeque(initial_capacity=4) using a circular array. Provide append_left(value), append_right(value), pop_left(), pop_right(), to_list(), __len__(), and the read-only capacity property. Pushes and pops at either end should be O(1) amortized. When a full deque receives an append, allocate an array with twice the capacity and copy current values in logical left-to-right order before completing the append.

initial_capacity is a positive ordinary integer. Values are unrestricted, including None and duplicates. Popping from an empty deque raises IndexError. This contract intentionally requires growth only; no shrink policy is assumed.

example.reasoning: Appending to a full two-slot buffer grows it before preserving order.
